description: Registry of decision points: every place where Go consults a random source on the request path. Both implementations replace the random draw at these exact sites with a lookup of envelope.decisions[id]; when the envelope has no value they draw from their own random source and record source 'rng'. A decision is recorded in trace.decisions only when the site is actually reached (for example floors.skip is not consulted when every skip rate is 0). Value domains: 'binary' is the integer 0 or 1 with the meaning given in 'values'; 'index' is a zero-based integer; 'enum' is one of the listed strings. An out-of-domain envelope value is ignored, the real random source is used, and the decision carries a note. Rate-driven points (floors.skip, floors.data_rate, floors.enforce) honour the envelope only where the configured rates leave the outcome to chance: where a rate of 0 or 100 fixes it (consulted_when), the site computes the fixed outcome, records it with source 'rng' and, when the envelope pinned the point, adds the note 'envelope override ignored: the configured rate fixes the outcome'. Pinning a fixed outcome would make the server behave unlike production (observer effect).

decisions.go_site: floors/floors.go:70 shouldSkipFloors(..., rand.Intn); floors/rule.go:179 skipRate >= f(skipRateMax+1)
decisions.consulted_when: the selected model group, the floors data or the floors root has a non-zero skipRate; the envelope is honoured only for a skipRate in 1..99 (100 always skips)
dynamic fetch returned data and usefetchdatarate is set; the envelope is honoured only for a usefetchdatarate in 1..99 (0 never and 100 always uses fetched data)

values.n: zero-based index of the winning model group after Go's stable ascending sort by modelweight (floors/rule.go:145)

decisions.consulted_when: the floors data has more than one valid model group
decisions.rng_equivalent: the first sorted group at which the running weight sum reaches rand.Intn(totalWeight+1)

decisions.consulted_when: floors are enforced for the request (floors enabled, enforcepbs not false); the envelope is honoured only when neither enforce rate is negative and at least one is in 1..99 (0 and 100 mean always)
decisions.rng_equivalent: 1 when both the request and the account enforce rate are 0 or greater than rand.Intn(100), else 0

values.0: keep the earlier (dupe) bid, drop the current one
values.1: drop the earlier (dupe) bid, keep the current one

decisions.consulted_when: two bids map to the same category/duration key with equal price
the account bid rounding mode is timesplit, once per rounded price
every cookie_sync request that chooses bidders to sync

not_decisions.policy: not overridden: any order is Go-compatible, so seatbid order is normalized instead (normalization.json seatbid_order)
disabled through the parity config profile
